{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|eff= local

|gr1= High Command

|descr= Sets if group icons added with [[addGroupIcon]] are visible on map and in the HUD.

|s1= [[setGroupIconsVisible]] [showOnMap, showOnHUD]

|p1= showOnMap: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to show on map. Default is [[false]]

|p2= showOnHUD: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to show on HUD. Default is [[false]]

|r1= [[Nothing]] (prior to {{arma3}} v1.94 this command returned [[Object]] of [[objNull|null]] value)

|x1= <sqf>
setGroupIconsVisible [true, true];
(group player) addGroupIcon ["b_inf", [0, 0]];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[addGroupIcon]] [[clearGroupIcons]] [[getGroupIcon]] [[getGroupIconParams]] [[groupIconSelectable]] [[groupIconsVisible]] [[onGroupIconClick]] [[removeGroupIcon]] [[setGroupIcon]] [[setGroupIconParams]] [[setGroupIconsSelectable]]
}}
